name: cz.refstats/refstats
title: RefStats
description: Hockey referee and penalty stats: who referees tonight's games, averages vs the league.

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: All competitions RefStats covers with competition_id, current season, games played and league averages (minor penalties, majors, PIM per game). Use competition_id to filter other tools.

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Games on a date (or date range, max 7 days) with the assigned referees and each referee's average minor penalties per game this season in that competition, next to the league average. Finished games include penalty totals per team. Referees are known once the league announces them (usually on game day). Dates are Prague dates: NHL and AHL evening games in North America start after midnight in Prague, so tonight's NHL games are listed under tomorrow's date. Max 150 games.

date_to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD for a range (max 7 days after date).

competition_id.description: Filter by competition (see list_competitions), e.g. 5 = NHL, 1 = Czech Extraliga.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One game by match_id: teams, referees, penalty totals and every penalty (minute, team, player, length, reason). For NHL, Czech Extraliga and Maxa liga also the score and goals; for games in progress the live state (period, live penalty counts and penalties so far).

match_id.description: match_id from get_games or other tools.

tools.name: search_referee
tools.description: Find a referee by name (diacritics optional, part of the name is enough) or referee_id. Returns matching candidates and, for the best match (most games), averages per competition and season (minor penalties, majors, PIM per game) next to the league average, plus the last 10 games. Search another candidate by its referee_id.

tools.name: search_team
tools.description: Find a team (club) by name or team_id. Returns candidates and, for the best match, per competition and season: own and opponent minor penalties per game vs the league average per team, majors and PIM; this season's most penalized players and most common minor penalties.

tools.name: search_player
tools.description: Find a player by name or player_id. Returns candidates (with penalty counts) and, for the best match, games played, minor and major penalties and PIM per competition and season, plus the most common penalty types.

tools.name: season_leaderboards
tools.description: RefBoard: current-season records and top 10 lists for one competition or all together — games with the most penalties, most penalized teams and players, referees and referee pairs with the most games and the highest/lowest averages (minimum games apply). Inner field names are Czech: hodnota = value, zapasu = games, prumer = average, stejne = games with the same value.

competition_id.description: Competition (see list_competitions). Omit for all competitions together.
